checks.name: Sitemap pages answer 200 with no indexing error
checks.fix: Fix the sitemap URLs that error (status, noindex, canonical elsewhere, redirect or robots block) in scripts/seo-check.mjs output, or drop them from app/sitemap.ts.

checks.name: robots.txt answers and names the sitemap
checks.fix: Serve robots.txt with a Sitemap: line (apps/web/app/robots.ts).

checks.name: Every sitemap URL has a lastmod date
checks.fix: Give every entry in apps/web/app/sitemap.ts a lastModified from the record's updatedAt.

checks.name: Indexable pages linked on the site are in the sitemap
checks.detail: 31 indexable pages linked but not submitted
checks.fix: Add the linked, indexable pages that are missing to apps/web/app/sitemap.ts, or noindex them if they should not rank.

checks.name: No internal link is broken or redirects
checks.fix: Point the broken or redirecting internal links straight at the final 200 URL.

checks.name: Titles 30-61 characters
checks.fix: Rewrite the titles that are too short or too long (30-61 characters, the item or topic first, '| YardSwaps' last).

checks.name: Meta descriptions 70-160 characters
checks.fix: Write a 70-160 character description for each page listed; for listings, build it from title, price, condition and city.

checks.name: Titles and descriptions are unique
checks.detail: 4 pages share a title or description
checks.fix: Make duplicate listing titles and descriptions unique (add year, make, model or city).

checks.name: Exactly one H1 per page
checks.fix: Give each page listed exactly one <h1> naming the page's subject.

checks.name: At least 600 characters of server-rendered text
checks.fix: Add useful server-rendered text to the thin pages (specs, what it is used for, pickup area).

checks.name: Images have alt text
checks.fix: Add alt text to every on the pages listed (item name for listing photos, empty alt for decoration).

checks.name: JSON-LD parses on every page
checks.detail: 0 pages with JSON-LD that does not parse
checks.fix: Fix the JSON-LD blocks that fail to parse on the pages listed.

checks.name: Listing Product markup has what Google needs (image, offer)
checks.detail: 2 of 137 listings missing a Product field
checks.fix: In the listing page's Product JSON-LD, always include image (fall back to the category photo when a listing has none) and an Offer with price and priceCurrency.

checks.name: Home page has Organization and WebSite markup
checks.fix: Add Organization (name, logo, sameAs social links) and WebSite (with SearchAction) JSON-LD to the home page.

checks.name: llms.txt describes the site with links
checks.fix: Serve /llms.txt with the one-line description and links to categories, guides and key pages.

checks.name: Answer engines may read the site (robots.txt)
checks.fix: Remove the Disallow: / groups for answer-engine crawlers in apps/web/app/robots.ts (training can stay off through Content-Signal).

checks.name: Articles use question headings
checks.fix: Rewrite at least two H2s per article as the question a buyer would ask (agents/BLOG-WRITER-PROMPT.md in yardswaps-media).

checks.name: Article markup has a date and an author
checks.fix: Give the BlogPosting JSON-LD on /blog/[slug] an author (the 'YardSwaps team' Organization) next to datePublished and dateModified.

checks.name: Articles open with takeaways or carry an FAQ
checks.fix: Start each article with a short 'Key takeaways' list and end with an FAQ section marked up as FAQPage.

checks.name: HTML under 500 KB (uncompressed)
checks.detail: 26 of 26 sampled pages heavier; largest 1100 KB
checks.fix: Trim the server HTML of the heavy pages: fewer listings inlined in the RSC payload, no duplicated JSON (docs/web-performance.md).

checks.name: Images have width and height
checks.fix: Render the unsized images through next/image or ListingImg with width and height so the layout doesn't shift.

checks.name: lang attribute and viewport meta
checks.fix: Set <html lang="en"> and the viewport meta in app/layout.tsx.

checks.name: HTTPS with HSTS
checks.fix: Send Strict-Transport-Security with max-age of at least a year.

checks.name: HTML is compressed
checks.fix: Serve HTML with br or gzip.

checks.name: Share cards (og:title and og:image)
checks.fix: Add openGraph title and image to generateMetadata on the pages listed.

checks.name: Pages answer in under 800 ms on average
checks.fix: Cache the slow server queries on the pages listed (unstable_cache or revalidate) and check the Railway region.
